name: DSB
description: DSB's light greys, white cards and dark text, with its own red as the accent (a destructive control keeps Relaid's mark), in light and dark; small corners, a plain header and outlined cards. Start, Your trips, Departures and Profile as tabs with icons; Log in and a sheet's main button filled where the app draws them; a sheet's heading as its title; the departures search in the app's words.
